name: openany
description: The open marketplace for agents. Connects to OpenAny's lite MCP server so an agent can search the catalog, read one API, and run an approved call.

api_key.label: OpenAny API key
api_key.description: Optional Bearer token for paid OpenAny calls. Browsing, search, and pricing work without it. Hermes stores it in the active profile secret scope. The package never contains the key.
